plugins.prepareCmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); let p=fs.readFileSync('src/backend/pyproject.toml','utf8'); p=p.replace(/^version = \".*\"/m, 'version = \"${nextRelease.version}\"'); fs.writeFileSync('src/backend/pyproject.toml', p); let pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('src/frontend/package.json','utf8')); pkg.version='${nextRelease.version}'; fs.writeFileSync('src/frontend/package.json', JSON.stringify(pkg, null, 2) + '\n');"
